metadata.design: Large Ranger Ark habitat atrium for a well-funded ecological disaster response campaign. Designed as a living reserve for active and boxed Pokemon.
rotomTableNotes: schemaVersion 2 map: sparse 1x1x1 terrain voxels plus empty placements.
Tokens usually stand at y=1 on floor voxels at y=0; upper catwalk tokens stand at y=9.
Transparent voxel materials are persisted; lagoon water uses shallow_water and deep_water materials.
Decals, props, zones, and doors are not used because the current map runtime strips/ignores retired object layers.
